name: Autocam Medical
old_description: A global contract manufacturer of orthopedic implants, spinal implants, precision instruments and orthopedic cutting tools.
about:
Autocam Medical, a privately held contract manufacturer, operates its global headquarters from a 100,000-square-foot facility in Kentwood, Michigan, with additional production sites in Plymouth, Massachusetts; Murfreesboro, Tennessee; Warsaw, Indiana; and Suzhou, China. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders publicly.

The firm specializes in high-precision machining of orthopedic and spinal implants, surgical instruments, and cutting tools. Its product range includes surgical drill bits, drivers, screws, plates, and complex handpieces for procedures spanning spine, foot and ankle, hand and wrist, hip and knee, shoulder and elbow, and craniomaxillofacial applications. Core processes comprise CNC milling, turning, and cutter grinding, supported by design-for-manufacturing engineering and proprietary process technology. The Kentwood campus, completed with a $60 million investment, is expected to add 250 jobs as production scales.

Autocam Medical serves original equipment manufacturers in the orthopedic device sector, supplying components for instruments and implants used across major anatomical categories. Customers include companies developing devices for spinal fusion, joint replacement, trauma fixation, and cranial surgery.

The company emphasizes a value-added approach that integrates state-of-the-art equipment with design-for-manufacturing expertise to reduce cost and accelerate time to market for highly engineered surgical components.

name: AutohausAZ
old_description: Though we’ve been selling car parts online since 2000, the Autohaus brand has been around since 1979. We first began selling parts for Euro cars in the late 1970’s. Back then, we specialized in Volvo replacement parts and distributing all Euro parts for Bosch throughout the Arizona valley. Fast forward to present day, and we are selling auto parts online exclusively to millions of do-it-yourselfers worldwide. Just because you find cheap auto parts on our website, we assure each and every one of our customers that we only carry, stock, and ship OEM quality new parts. You’ll never have to worry about getting used European parts from us.
about:
AutohausAZ traces its roots to 1979 when it opened as Autohaus Phoenix in Phoenix, Arizona, supplying European auto parts to local repair shops. The business launched its online store in 2000 and has since grown into a nationwide distributor with multiple warehouses serving hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide.

The company stocks a broad range of OEM and OE-quality replacement parts for European vehicles, covering brands such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volvo, Porsche, Audi, Volkswagen, Saab, Land Rover, and Mercedes Sprinter. Its catalog includes components from air filters and brake rotors to engine mounts and transmission fluids, all maintained by a team of specialists who verify fitment by year, make, model, and submodel. Orders placed before 2 PM MST ship the same day from the nearest warehouse, and the company backs every part with a three-year, 36-month warranty.

AutohausAZ serves both do-it-yourself enthusiasts and professional repair shops, offering discounted pricing that the company says runs 20 to 90 percent below retail and wholesale levels. Customers include independent mechanics, dealership service departments, and individual owners performing their own maintenance on European makes.

The business was founded to fill a gap in the Phoenix market for reliable European auto parts, and it continues to emphasize direct sourcing, low markups, and a fitment-first catalog as its primary differentiators. A financing option allows buyers to spread the cost of unexpected repairs over time.

name: Autokiniton - Greenville
old_description: Autokiniton US Holdings, Inc. today announced the completion of its acquisition of Tower International, Inc. (NYSE: TOWR) (“Tower”), a leading manufacturer of engineered automotive structural metal components and assemblies, for $31 per share in cash. AGG is a subsidiary of Autokiniton Global Group, LP, a portfolio company of KPS Capital Partners, LP (“KPS”), a leading global private equity firm with approximately $5.1 billion of assets under management, as of June 30, 2019.
about:
Autokiniton’s Greenville-area operation is part of a global automotive supplier formed in May 2018 when KPS Capital Partners and George Thanopoulos created Autokiniton Global Group to acquire L&W Group, a Tier 1 specialist in metal stampings, welded assemblies and tubular products. The combined entity acquired Tower International in September 2019, creating the second-largest body-in-white and vehicle-frame supplier in North America with $2.3 billion in annual sales. The company is headquartered in Fountain Inn, South Carolina, and operates as a private-equity-backed manufacturer.

The company produces high-strength structural components and precision stamping assemblies for vehicle body-in-white and frame structures. Its manufacturing portfolio includes joining and welding (MIG, resistance spot, laser, friction stir, capacitive discharge and drawn arc), complex assemblies such as front/rear floor pans and door/pillar units, tube forming on three tube mills and two roll-form mills, cold stamping on 214 tandem presses (up to 3,000 tons), 40 transfer presses (up to 3,000 tons) and 105 progressive presses (up to 1,600 tons), hot stamping on eight lines with 23 in-die quenching lasers, and laser cutting on 40 machines. facilities, four in Mexico, one in Brazil and a technology center in India.

Autokiniton serves the automotive industry as a Tier 1 supplier to the world’s automakers — Ford recognized the company with a World Excellence Award in 2021 — and also supplies tubular products to the trailer and recreational vehicle markets. Its plants are strategically located near customer assembly sites to streamline logistics.

The company says its differentiation comes from a focus on value-driven, sustainable lightweighting solutions, proprietary expertise in joining dissimilar metals (aluminum, hot-formed and ultra-high-strength steels), extensive press and hot-stamping capacity, a global footprint co-located with OEMs, and a culture that prioritizes speed, simplification and empowered problem-solving over bureaucracy.

name: Autoliv North America Inc (OTC)
old_description: Autoliv has developed its first complete wearable protection for motorcycle riders: a vest with an integrated airbag system designed to reduce critical injury risks in the event of a crash. This system is now being launched in collaboration with RS Taichi, a leading manufacturer of motorcycle riding gear, who will bring it to market.
about:
Headquartered in Ogden, Utah, Autoliv North America operates as the U.S. arm of the global Autoliv group, the world's largest automotive safety supplier.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures passive safety systems — including airbags, seatbelts, steering wheels, and pyrotechnical safety switches — for virtually every major automaker. It also produces mobility safety solutions such as a motorcycle airbag vest developed with RS Taichi. Autoliv runs 13 technical centers and 20 test tracks across 25 countries, employing roughly 65,000 people, and reported $10.8 billion in net sales for 2025.

Its customers span the automotive industry, commercial vehicle manufacturers, and emerging mobility sectors. Recent collaborations include partnerships with XPENG and Great Wall Motor to advance safer mobility worldwide, and the RS Taichi venture brings motorcycle safety gear to market.

Autoliv states its mission is "Saving More Lives," citing that its products saved an estimated 40,000 lives and prevented 600,000 injuries in 2025. The company has set a target of carbon-neutral operations by 2030 and emphasizes digitalization and automation as cornerstones of its operational excellence.

name: Automated Food Systems
old_description: We build high-performance Food Processing Systems for the production of
about:
Automated Food Systems, based in Waxahachie, Texas, was founded in 1976 by mechanical engineer Glenn Walser. With a single investor, Walser developed the world's first automated corn dog system after a food processor sought a method to automate production—a challenge others deemed impossible.

The company designs, manufactures, and integrates custom food processing and material handling equipment for stick and skewered foods. Its product line includes corn dog systems (3,000–16,000 units per hour), kebab and skewer systems (up to 4,080 units per hour), funnel cake systems, market-entry systems, industrial batter mixers (60–180 gallon capacities), food pumps (up to 223 GPM), and food-grade skewers and sticks. Equipment is built to withstand harsh processing environments and is customized to each facility's space and process requirements.

Customers range from small producers to the largest multinational food processing companies, with installations across North America, South America, Africa, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The company serves the corn dog, kebab, funnel cake, and broader industrial food manufacturing sectors.

AFS emphasizes service and support for the life of each system, including a dedicated parts inventory, on-site training, plant layout optimization, and custom design and fabrication for unique food automation challenges. The business began with a single problem-solving mission and continues to engineer solutions for unique food processing challenges.

name: Automotive Charging & Starting LLC
old_description: Automotive Charging & Starting was founded by Brian Webb in 2011. With over 20 years experience at AC&S, we have learned how the right care and knowledge will extend the life and performance of any car or truck. We are determined to truly offer value to the community and to always provide outstanding service.
about:
Automotive Charging & Starting LLC was founded in 2011 by Brian Webb in Idaho Falls, Idaho. Webb brought over 20 years of experience from AC&S to the venture, which operates as an independently owned and operated shop serving the local community and surrounding region.

The company provides battery sales, service, and recycling, along with repair services for alternators, starters, generators, and DC motors. It maintains a large inventory of parts from OEM and aftermarket suppliers such as Delco, Bosch, Denso, and Mitsubishi, and offers same-day completion on most jobs unless parts must be ordered. A 24-hour emergency service, free battery checks, free installation, and a battery buy-back program round out the service lineup.

Customers span automotive, commercial, industrial, agricultural, marine, and recreational sectors. The shop services all major vehicle manufacturers, including brands from Japan (Acura, Toyota, Honda), Europe (Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz), and the United States (Ford, Chevrolet, Ram, Jeep), as well as heavy-duty trucks, agricultural equipment, and marine deep-cycle applications.

Webb started the business to deliver genuine value and outstanding service to the community, emphasizing a no-hassle guarantee and free diagnosis of no-start conditions to recommend the least expensive solution rather than selling unnecessary parts.

name: Automotive Equipment of Nevada
old_description: AEN has been serving the automotive industry for over 34 years. We are a full-service automotive shop equipment distributor, selling and servicing the top-tier automotive shop equipment brands.
about:
Established in 2006 in Las Vegas, Nevada, Automotive Equipment of Nevada (AEN) draws on over 34 years of combined experience in the automotive equipment sector. The company operates as a full-service distributor, selling and servicing brands of automotive shop equipment.

AEN provides a complete range of services including equipment sales, shop design, installation, and repair. Its sales portfolio spans individual items such as jacks and oil reels up to complete alignment systems and frame-pulling bays. The design team specializes in ground-up dealership construction and major remodels, coordinating with general contractors to specify equipment early and avoid change orders. Installation crews handle projects from single lifts to facilities with more than 80 in-ground lifts, while the service department, backed by over 20 years of repair experience, addresses issues ranging from stuck lifts to leaking hydraulic lines.

The company serves automotive dealerships, independent repair shops, and collision centers throughout Nevada. Recent projects have included outfitting new-build dealerships with full equipment packages and retrofitting existing bays with alignment and frame equipment. Customers range from single-bay operations to multi-location dealer groups seeking coordinated equipment solutions.

AEN differentiates itself by integrating sales, design, installation, and service under one roof, ensuring that all equipment works together harmoniously. The firm holds Nevada contractor licenses 86133 and 86134, underscoring its compliance with state regulations for construction and installation work.

name: Automotive Supply Center
old_description: Automotive Supply Center (ASC) has served the Hilo community since 1955. Our inventory of new and rebuilt automotive parts, supplies, and paint means you can be sure to find everything for a foreign or domestic car, truck, and high-performance vehicles. ASC is the auto parts shop to equip your vehicle and keep it running at optimum performance. We also have three warehouses stocked with a variety of automotive parts to serve you.
about:
Automotive Supply Center (ASC) has operated in Hilo, Hawaii, since 1955 when brothers Kazuichi and Hayato Okino opened a small auto parts shop on Piopio Street with three full-time and two part-time employees. A tsunami destroyed the original location on May 1, 1960, prompting a move to the Kanoelehua Industrial Park area the following year. The business relocated again in 1996 to its current address at 411 E Kawili St., where it now runs three warehouses.

The company stocks and sells new and rebuilt automotive parts, supplies, paint, and accessories for domestic and imported cars, trucks, and high-performance vehicles. Its inventory spans auto motor parts, electrical components, air conditioning parts, batteries, detailing products, auto body supplies, fluids, and tools. Today, Peter Okino and his son Darin Okino manage a staff of over 35 employees, many recruited from Hawaii Community College’s auto body and repair programs, with some technicians boasting over 30 years of experience.

ASC serves retail and commercial customers across the Big Island, including DIY vehicle owners, repair shops, and fleet operators needing parts for everything from light trucks to heavy-duty 4×4s. The shop carries parts for major brands such as Honda, Ford, and Toyota, and supports both foreign and domestic models.

The Okino family attributes the company’s longevity to its knowledgeable staff and deep local ties, which enable a wide inventory selection and competitive pricing. The business was founded to meet the community’s need for reliable automotive parts and has adapted through natural disasters and growth while remaining locally based.

about:
Founded in 1981 in Baltimore, Maryland, Avalon Industries remains a family-owned company organized around two distinct divisions. The business was established to manufacture protective carrying solutions and has grown to include a full-service promotional products operation.

The core manufacturing division produces soft-sided carrying cases, bags, totes, and molded laminate cases engineered to hold and transport supplies and equipment for commercial and military use. The second division, Avalon Promotional Products, operates as an advertising specialties distributor, providing personalized apparel, uniforms, and branded merchandise for brand identification and promotion campaigns.

For several years, both divisions have supplied the U.S. defense department, first-responder organizations, school systems, municipal governments, youth sports leagues, and a broad commercial client base. The manufacturer focuses on durable sewn and laminated case goods, while the promotional arm handles decoration, sourcing, and distribution of logoed apparel and merchandise.

name: Avon Food Company
old_description: Founded by family, now led by the next generation, Avon Food Co. blends heritage, innovation, and SQF-certified precision to bring bold flavors to shelves nationwide.
about:
Avon Food Company operates from a 55,000-square-foot facility in Stoughton, Massachusetts. The business was founded in 2002 by Stephen and Heidee Anastos as a small family-run operation focused on sauces, dressings, and marinades. Today, the company is led by their son, Michael Anastos, who has expanded the operation while maintaining its family-owned character.

The company produces liquid and dry food products including sauces, dressings, marinades, and custom spice blends. Its SQF-certified facility houses four dedicated production lines: an electromagnetic filler for high-speed liquid filling, pressure overflow and piston fillers for varied viscosities, an auger filler for dry spices, and a line for 5-gallon pail and bag-in-box packaging. With a team of 35-plus employees, Avon handles everything from research and development and custom formulation to private-label manufacturing, storage, and delivery, producing more than 300 distinct items for clients ranging from startups to established brands.

Avon serves food brands and private-label partners across North America, offering nationwide shipping and regional delivery from its Massachusetts base. Its customer base includes both emerging companies seeking recipe development and scale-up support and larger brands requiring consistent, high-volume co-packing. The company's in-house R&D team assists with flavor testing, ingredient sourcing, and scalability assessments to bring concepts to market-ready products.

Avon emphasizes its family-owned, next-generation leadership as a differentiator, combining heritage with investments in automation and technology. The company cites its SQF and HACCP compliance, allergen management, and traceability programs as the foundation of its quality assurance, while highlighting a partnership-first approach that treats each brand with the same care as its own.
